intended_object: One chunk of a hard-coded lookup table for a vertex permutation (permutation 2, chunk 3) of a 481-vertex graph. It is used in a computer-checked bound on the Hadwiger–Nelson problem. This comes from the docstring and the module name.
explanation: The definition is a raw data table that maps indices 0–63 to vertex labels in `Fin 481`, with a default value for all other inputs. It is an implementation detail of a computational proof (a piece of a graph symmetry, split into chunks to keep elaboration manageable). It does not correspond to any standard mathematical concept, so `not_a_mathematical_object` is the right verdict.
